name: ⛏️Dig to Save Brainrot
desc:
⛏️ Welcome to Dig to Save Brainrot⛏️

👍 Like the game and join the group

How to play:
💰 Break through layers of earth to discover rare Brainrots!
⚒️ Upgrade your pickaxes to mine quicker and unlock deeper zones!
🎯 Save the Brainrots to earn more trophies to unlock the next world!
🐾 Collect and hatch eggs to get special Brainrots that give powerful boosts!
✈️ Explore new worlds, each packed with unique resources and mysteries!

💻 Supports Desktop, Mobile and Tablet players
